store.summary: Four-track groovebox: drum machine, JUNO/DX7 synths, sampler, sequencer and tape arrangement.
store.description:
Cardenza Synth is a portable four-track synthesizer workstation with four built-in sound engines — a drum machine, a Juno-style analog synth, a DX7-style FM synth, and a sampler — plus per-track sequencing, song arrangement, mixing, per-track and bus effects, and SD-card project storage.

This release is a CardputerZero port of the upstream CardenzaSynth project: it faithfully reproduces the original's four sound engines, per-track sequencing and song arrangement, with the interface and controls re-adapted to the CP0's 320x170 screen and 46-key keyboard. The drum machine and synths are built in; the sampler plays your own audio — drop mono 16-bit 44.1 kHz WAV files into ~/.local/share/cardenza/sdcard/CardenzaSynth/Samples/ (user config lives in ~/.config/Cardenza/).

zh-CN.summary: 四轨 Groovebox 合成器：808 鼓机、JUNO/DX7 合成器、采样器、步进音序与磁带编曲。
zh-CN.description:
鸣片（Cardenza Synth）是一台便携式四轨合成器工作站，内置四种音源引擎（808 鼓机、Juno 模拟合成器、DX7 FM 合成器、采样器），支持分轨音序器、歌曲编排、混音、轨道与总线效果器，以及 SD 卡工程存储。

本版为 CardenzaSynth 上游项目的 CardputerZero 移植版：忠实还原原作的四种音源引擎、分轨音序与歌曲编排，并针对 CP0 的 320×170 屏幕与 46 键键盘重新适配界面与操作。鼓机与合成器为内置；采样器播放你自己的音频——把 16-bit/44.1kHz 单声道 WAV 放进 ~/.local/share/cardenza/sdcard/CardenzaSynth/Samples/ 即可（配置存于 ~/.config/Cardenza/）。
